notes:
Teacher 1.20.9, console 2.3.28, teacher laptop 1.0.0.
- Classes now open the way teachers are used to: your class list, then the learners in the class, then their marks
- The class list shows each class with its learners, your subjects and how many marks are still to be entered this term
- Inside a class, the first tab is Students: search any learner and tap straight into their detail
- Teachers are never left with an empty app: if the phone cannot match you to a staff record, you still see the school's classes with a clear message, and 'Find my classes' fixes the link
- Learners still appear when a class was recreated for a new year, so a promoted class no longer shows as empty
- Sending marks works without a cloud account: write the bundle and share it on WhatsApp for the head teacher to import
